# Voisu

> Voisu is free, MIT-licensed voice dictation for Linux (Fedora, Arch, Debian/Ubuntu) and Windows 10/11. Press a key, speak, and the Transcript is pasted where you were typing. It uses your own Deepgram and Groq API keys and has no account, server or analytics of its own.

Agents installing Voisu for a user: follow the agent install guide below. Never ask the user to paste API keys into the chat; they type them into Voisu's own setup (`voisu setup` on Linux, the settings window on Windows).

## Agents

- [Agent install guide](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/agent-install.md): exact commands per platform, the steps only the human can do, and verification checks

## Docs

- [Overview](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/): what Voisu is, and the words the docs use (Recording, Transcript, Trigger Key, Delivery, Overlay)
- [Getting started](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/getting-started.html): install on Windows, Fedora, Arch or Debian/Ubuntu, add keys, make the first Recording
- [Install with an agent](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/agents.html): copyable prompts for Claude Code, Codex and other terminal agents
- [Dictating](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/using.html): gestures, the capsule's states, where text goes, recovering a Transcript
- [Providers & API keys](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/providers.html): what Deepgram and Groq do, getting and storing keys, local transcription on Linux
- [Settings & commands](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/settings.html): the Windows settings window and tray, every Linux `voisu` command, file locations
- [Troubleshooting](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/troubleshooting.html): Trigger Key, portals, keys, microphone, failed pastes, SmartScreen, bug reports

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/privacy.html): what leaves the computer and what stays on it
- [Updating & uninstalling](https://anuraj-dev.github.io/voisu/docs/updating.html): updates on each platform and clean removal
